fields.name: chain
fields.description: Chain the event was observed on.

fields.name: token_address
fields.description: Address of the launched ERC-20 token.

fields.name: launchpad
fields.description: Launchpad that emitted the event.

fields.name: version
fields.description: nad.fun launch generation: `old` (contract_version `v3`) or `v2` (contract_version `nadfun-v2`).

fields.name: contract_version
fields.description: Label of the bonding-curve contract that emitted the event.

fields.name: contract_address
fields.description: Bonding-curve contract that emitted the event.

fields.name: creator
fields.description: Address that launched the token.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Token name as recorded at launch. User-chosen, may contain any Unicode.

fields.name: symbol
fields.description: Token symbol as recorded at launch. User-chosen.

fields.name: token_uri
fields.description: URI of the token's off-chain metadata JSON.

fields.name: quote_token
fields.description: Token the curve is priced in. Usually WMON (`0x3bd359c1119da7da1d913d1c4d2b7c461115433a`); some `v2` tokens pair with other tokens.

fields.name: pool_address
fields.description: Pool address recorded for the token at launch.

fields.name: virtual_quote_reserve
fields.description: Initial virtual reserve of the quote token on the curve.

fields.name: virtual_token_reserve
fields.description: Initial virtual reserve of the launched token on the curve.

fields.name: target_token_amount
fields.description: Target token amount of the curve.

fields.name: min_token_reserve
fields.description: Minimum token reserve of the curve. Only set for `v2` tokens.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Timestamp of the block containing the launch event.

fields.name: block_number
fields.description: Block containing the event.

fields.name: tx_hash
fields.description: Transaction containing the event.

fields.name: log_index
fields.description: Position of the event log within its block.
